findings.body: Decision 0100 still has `status: accepted` at line 2. Adding `superseded_by` alone leaves both conflicting ceilings accepted instead of completing the requested supersession. Forge's own acceptance implementation sets both `status="superseded"` and `superseded_by` (src/forge/records.py:306–307), as previous decision 0099 also demonstrates. Change 0100's status to `superseded`. Reaccepting 0101 will not repair this because already accepted decisions return immediately (src/forge/records.py:248–250).
